contract.scope: synthetic native API/layout/gradient check, not a scientific data experiment

config.precision: frozen high/TF32 FP32 PointNet/query; native FP16 compute/FP32 masters

shared_synthetic_inputs.generator: independent CPU generator, no source fields/targets

native_layout.encoded_width_proof: official Composite/Encoding alignment source plus measured total7770496 consistent with36864 MLP weights; internal encoded width not independently exposed/measured by this public API

source_config.method: GeoBC matched Euclidean-interface versus mesh-edge-distance context candidate
source_config.claim: distance-representation utility ablation; no new algorithm/stiffness/generalization claim

conditioned_field.claim: GeoBC candidate baseline; no new-algorithm or generalization claim

decoder.precision: native TCNN FP16 computation, FP32 master parameters, float32 returned output

encoder.pooling: concatenated masked max and masked mean

conditioned_field.conditioning: original38 then active interface5 then actual query32 then global32
conditioned_field.geometry_source: unchanged saved canonical actual-BC-role5 cloud; distance5 supplied only as external query inputs
conditioned_field.geometry_sampling: CAD-key/seed-stable sampling without replacement; masked padding for small clouds
conditioned_field.context_gradient: index_select/concatenate preserve gradients through native TCNN inputs
conditioned_field.context_training_cache: clouds only; re-encode once per unique CAD each optimizer step
conditioned_field.control: none/id retain the same decoder condition dimension and width as shape
conditioned_field.id_policy: fixed case identity codes for a diagnostic only; cannot encode unseen geometry

query_context.distance: direct FP32 coordinate differences squared, no TF32 dot distance
query_context.weights: masked softmax(-squared_distance/(2*sigma^2)); valid cloud weights sum1
query_context.pool_matmul_precision: FP32 tensors; pooling follows the trainer's high/TF32 matmul setting
query_context.order: point64 -> Linear64to32 -> Gaussian weighted pool -> non-affine LayerNorm32 -> tanh
query_context.linear_projection_before_pool: equivalent to postpool linear in exact arithmetic because weights sum1
query_context.zero_control: None; query32 remains actual on BOTH distance modes
query_context.state_cache: explicit geometry-context bundle per optimizer step, no data_ptr/implicit mutable lookup

source_config.coefficient_source: external target-independent reference-load metadata; no files parsed here
source_config.input_layout: masked original25 +local13 +active interface5 +actual query32 +global32 =107 Identity conditions
source_config.scale_policy: trainer directly reuses existing TRAIN120 common u RMS with center0; model reads/fits no scale
source_config.physical_decode: u_mm = common_u_scale_mm * scaled_u; no per-load bias or learned scale
source_config.stress_policy: No stress output, training, scale fitting or linear stress combination in this module
source_config.linearity_scope: linear_basis only, with identical geometry and nonload BC/material/local features; load_dependent_basis need not be load-linear
source_config.role_source: same fixed canonical ver cloud nodes; support union any original25 DOF0:6; load member original25 column6
source_config.role_control: retain the same actual canonical support_union/load_member cloud channels on BOTH distance modes

query_context.pool_matmul_precision: FP32 tensors; pooling follows the trainer's high/TF32 matmul setting
query_context.order: point64 -> Linear64to32 -> Gaussian weighted pool -> non-affine LayerNorm32 -> tanh
query_context.linear_projection_before_pool: equivalent to postpool linear in exact arithmetic because weights sum1
query_context.zero_control: None; query32 remains actual on BOTH distance modes
query_context.state_cache: explicit geometry-context bundle per optimizer step, no data_ptr/implicit mutable lookup

capacity_cost.native_padding_policy: Composite pads its final Identity107 to120 with13ones, total24+120=144; actual public combined native.numel must be checked
capacity_cost.historical_control_limit: Both fresh distance models have enlarged equal architecture; old smaller query/native initialization is not a matched control
capacity_cost.distance_limit: Matched source groups and active feature count; different distance distributions/conditioning still prevent a pure topology-causality claim

interface_distance.source_order: four support member groups sorted by master GRID ID, then actual loaded member group
interface_distance.normalization: same physical endpoint distance/L; no fitted transform or clipping
interface_distance.source: external target-independent original-node cache, verified by trainer; no data/graph construction here
interface_distance.scope_limit: edge-graph paths are not stiffness or exact continuous/remeshing-invariant geodesics
